observations: Viewed assets/panels/06-3.png and its place in page-06.png. Ravi keeps his sheet traits (thick low brows, square bearded jaw, side part, green shirt). The partner matches vision-cast.png: shoulder-length wavy hair, high arched brows, heart-shaped face, a mole under her right eye, gold hoops, mustard block-print kurta. The child matches too: big round eyes, round cheeks, small upturned nose, orange T-shirt, khaki shorts.

Hands mostly match the record. Ravi points gently at the tablet with his right (near) hand. His left arm runs along the sofa back, and the watch on that wrist confirms it is his. The partner holds the tablet with both hands at its edges. One child hand rests on the partner's arm and the other on the cushion; from this angle I could not confirm which of the child's hands is left and which is right.

Ravi's left arm reaches behind both the partner and the child, ending past the child's head. That is long but anatomically plausible, and the watch identifies the arm. The record says only 'behind his partner'.
The tablet shows three profile circles and a heart icon with no text, as the source asks. Everyone's expression is a warm, engaged smile. Nothing suggests diagnosis or treatment.

The vision separation is weaker than in 06-2. A pale-blue rounded fade frames the top and left, with connected-clinic silhouettes and dotted lines, but the right and bottom edges run to the panel border and the costume colours are fairly saturated. In the composed page, the 'WELBUK VISION' label, the airy left fade and the sky still separate it clearly from the present-day 06-4.
